events.name: Stuff Your Bass
events.description:
Forget subtle. Nov 20, the Ranchero Room turns into a full-blast EDM takeover and the bass is not asking permission — it's in your chest, your drink, your bones. Cabana Bass takes the decks and stitches together the hits you already scream in your car with low-end that rattles the walls.

This isn't background music — it's the whole night. Lights low, speakers loud, floor packed. One set bleeds into the next with zero filler, just drop after drop after drop.

Show up ready to move. Bring friends, bring energy, leave your inhibitions at the door — Azúcar's turning the bass up and there's no turning it back down.

10pm, Ranchero Room. Stuff Your Bass. You've been warned.

🗓️ Viernes 20 de noviembre — Show 10:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 18+ · Cover $15

events.name: Sip and Paint with ArtwithAubrey
events.description:
Forget blank canvases and pressure — this is sip-and-paint season, Azúcar style. Pull up a seat in the Ranchero Room while Art With Aubrey walks you through decorating your very own set of Christmas bulbs, one sip and one brushstroke at a time. No art degree required, just a little holiday chispa and a drink in hand.

Aubrey's got the instruction and inspiration covered, so whether you're painting a tiny masterpiece or something delightfully chaotic, you'll leave with ornaments nobody else has and a tree that actually looks like you. Glitter, color, a little sparkle in your glass — it's festive, it's forgiving, and it's made for laughing at your own art.

Come solo, bring your people, make it a date night — every bulb, every brushstroke, every body welcome. December 6th at 6pm, Ranchero Room. Come paint, sip, and deck your tree the Azúcar way.

🗓️ Domingo 6 de diciembre — Show 6:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $33
